t: Track Chain Protocol: Predecessor Linking + Cross-Tool Continuity

content.what: Implemented Track Chain Protocol enabling portable session continuity across tools/environments. Users can load a track from one tool, continue conversation in another, and generate new track that links to predecessor. Creates audit trail across conversation chains.
deliverables: Track detection when loaded as context (wai.md Step 5b)
Predecessor linking in track schema (session_metadata field)
content.use_case: Session A (Claude Code) → track_A.jsonl → Session B (ChatGPT Web) loads track_A → generates track_B (links to A) → Session C (Cursor) loads track_B → full chain reconstructable

resolution_reason: All deliverables implemented, tested against design spec, teaching file created for distribution. Protocol is production-ready.
